formula_review.rho: For f=1, V=s²+b²−2rho*s*b; Delta/sqrt(V)>=5 iff rho>=(s²+b²−(Delta/5)²)/(2*s*b). Sign is correct; interval must also obey |rho|<=1.
formula_review.bias: Adverse mean reduction a preserves nominal separation>=5 when a<=Delta−5sqrt(s²+b²), under independent background. This is a design margin only, not permission to ignore null bias.
formula_review.power: Under joint Gaussian and same null/alternative variance, P(Z>5)=SF(5−Delta/sqrt(s²+b²)); value0.619732 is detection probability of the stated alternative, not observed significance.
formula_review.ninety_percent: Let z90=5+Phi^-1(.9). Independence requires s<=sqrt((Delta/z90)²−b²); all correlations with conservative threshold5(s+b) require s<=Delta/z90−b. The positive radicand and positive bounds hold for the pinned case.
formula_review.all_correlation_uniformity: If Delta>=z90(s+b), then Delta−5(s+b)>0. For any actual Gaussian variance V<=(s+b)², P(D>5(s+b))=Phi((Delta−5(s+b))/sqrt(V))>=.9.
formula_review.factor: Applies to f=1 LCDM upper contrast only. Compatibility f=K has a different covariance coefficient and generally bilateral criterion.
